name: Pear-Blossom Vigil (Lê Hoa Thủ Tịch)

bonuses.effect: Until It Stops Wanting (Chí Bất Dục Chiến)
bonuses.rule: each toll of the bell on a foe held by your Frost Seal makes the hold last 1 s longer, and the foe deals 5 % less damage for 10 s; the tolls stack with no ceiling, and each fades on its own.

story: The abbess's three for the sit against the seal: the bell cast from the frozen tribulation's ice, the robe, and the Moonrime sword (the catalogue's ice-moonrime-sword, which carries no set field of its own). Thái wears all three; in 1202 she means to walk to the cave in them with the nun she chooses.

name: The Gate (Sơn Môn Tam Kiện)

bonuses.rule: after you block three hits, your next thrust is a sure crit and pierces the foe's ward.

story: The prioress's grey sword, the coat she was found in and the beads of the sisters who raised her: everything she owns, worn at the gate she has never left.
